text:
jessica: Heads-up — sudden GPU backlog in us-west-2, clients reporting 429s and timeouts. seeing queue lengths spike on fleet-pool-03. anyone else?
rahul: Confirmed. queue depth for p-s-03 > 600 for the last 10m. Autoscaler hitting region quota, so new nodes not coming up.
 dave: Are the 429s giving any guidance? Retry-After header or a custom hint? Customers complain SDKs are hammering.
 jessica: Mixed. Some responses have Retry-After: 1, others none. We occasionally emit X-RW-QUEUE-ESTIMATE but it's not stable.
 rahul: We rolled out an experiment yesterday that adds X-RW-CAPACITY: low|med|high and X-RW-BACKOFF-MS. Might be partially responsible for the inconsistent header surface.
 marta: From SDK side, inconsistency is hard. We prefer deterministic rules: prefer Retry-After if present, else read a numeric backoff header. If neither, fall back to expo jitter.
 dave: Agreed. Also want a 429 subcode in JSON body (eg code: "queue_saturated") so mobile apps can do graceful degradation rather than retries.
 rahul: Good call. Short-term mitigation: I'm going to gate some non-critical routes to a lower priority queue and push low-priority tenants to a separate burst pool if capacity permits.
 infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: us-west-2 GPU quota reached — compute.googleapis.com/quota?region=us-west-2
 jessica: Can we standardize on a small set of headers for clients to rely on? Proposal: 1) Retry-After (seconds) — canonical 2) X-RW-QUEUE-ESTIMATE (approx pending requests) 3) X-RW-BACKOFF-MS (recommended backoff in ms)
 marta: SDK implementable. We'll treat X-RW-BACKOFF-MS as advisory and cap with min_backoff_ms and max_retries. We'll add bounded concurrency per API key to avoid retry storms.
 dave: Also add fast-fail for synchronous low-latency flows (if header indicates queue_estimate > 200 -> return explicit error for caller to degrade).
 rahul: I'm going to open infra ticket RWF-341 to standardize header shapes and ensure the admission controller always sets at least one hint.
 jessica: Nice. Action items: rahul files RWF-341 and adds a short runbook note, marta will PR SDK changes to honor X-RW-BACKOFF-MS + bounded concurrency, dave will update client runbook for mobile fast-fail behavior.
 marta: I'll scope initial SDK change as opt-in behind beta flag so existing customers don't break. Will include example: ````js
// SDK pseudo
client.on429 = (resp) => {
  const retry = resp.headers['retry-after'] || Math.ceil(resp.headers['x-rw-backoff-ms']/1000) || null;
  if (retry) return sleepWithJitter(retry * 1000);
  // fallback expo jitter
};
````
 rahul: For admission controller, we'll also attach a short TTL token so SDKs can avoid re-enqueueing identical long requests repeatedly. Suggest header X-RW-ADMIT-TTL=200ms.
 jessica: Sounds good. Keep the on-call loop posted if autoscaler changes. We should also confirm cost impact of burst pool before moving low-priority tenants — ask finance for quick estimate.
 dave: I'll add a short note to the incident channel and to the eng-runbook. :thumbsup:
 marta: Will open SDK draft PR within the hour and include tests for mixed header cases.
 rahul: I'll start the infra ticket and add a patch to ensure at least one hint header is always present.
 jessica: Thanks all — let's reconvene in 20m if things don't settle.
